# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Before asking to push any code to `main`, always verify that the codebase passes Ruff checks and fix any Ruff-reported issues.

## Required workflow

1. Run Ruff against the files you changed, or the full repository if appropriate.
2. Fix every Ruff error and warning that is safe and relevant to the change.
3. Re-run Ruff to confirm there are no remaining issues.
4. Only after Ruff passes, suggest pushing or merging to `main`.

## Command examples

Use the repository's existing commands when available. Otherwise, use standard Ruff commands such as:

```bash
ruff check .
ruff check . --fix
